concept.name: Varkesh, the Ember-Tithe
concept.description: A hobgoblin sorcerer 3 with the elemental fire bloodline. An outcast arcane practitioner who has recruited goblins to collect a self-proclaimed tithe from isolated farms.

gear: piece of cured leather (mage armor focus)

details.sourceNotes: Sheet includes the selected active Mage Armor; do not add its +4 armor bonus again. Other temporary spells, including Enlarge Person, are inactive by default. Melee-focused heroic-array assignment: Str 14, Dex 14, Con 15, Int 8, Wis 10, Cha 15 before racial +2 Dex/+2 Con. NPC hp uses the repository's approved heroic-NPC house rule. Burning hands is the level-3 bloodline bonus spell, not a purchased extra known spell. Carries NPC-standard rather than PC-equivalent wealth; unspent gear budget is not treasure.
details.tactics: Mage Armor has already been cast once before the raid and is active in this profile (3-hour duration): the sheet's AC is already 16, touch 12, flat-footed 14; 5 first-level slots remain. Daily slot totals are capacity, not remaining resources. Do not also begin with shield active. Enlarge Person is castable as a 1-round prebuff on himself before contact: for 3 minutes he is Large (10-ft reach, CMB +6, CMD 17, AC 15, touch 11, sickle 2d6+3 at +3, ray +1); multiple size effects never stack, and projectiles leave his hands normal-sized. In combat without it, cast shield if threatened (AC 20, touch 12, flat-footed 18 for 3 minutes), otherwise advance behind a warrior and use elemental ray. Burning hands deals 3d4 fire, DC 13 Reflex half, in a 15-ft. cone; use it on a worthwhile angle rather than allies or helpless targets. Elemental ray is a standard-action spell-like ranged touch attack at 30 ft., 1d6+1 fire, 5/day. Acid splash may deal fire through bloodline arcana. Do not grant fire immunity to his followers.
details.morale: At 8 hp or fewer, or when both Sootfinger and two warriors have fallen, withdraw toward the orchard. If cornered, offer stolen provisions for safe passage. Does not attack downed PCs.
